site.name: Acordia
site.tagline: Chords that transpose correctly, with a metronome and the version you're playing.

home.title: Songs
home.empty: No songs yet. Upload the first one!
home.heroEyebrow: Chords for rehearsal and the stage
home.heroSubtitle: Change key without misspelled notes, use a capo without doing the math, and practice with a metronome and the original recording.
home.noResultsHint: Try another title or artist, or upload the song yourself.

instruments.bassNote: Play {note} at any of these positions.
instruments.soundingHint: With a capo, piano and bass see the chords that sound, not the guitar shapes.

add.title: Add a video or track
add.invalid: Paste a YouTube or Spotify link.
add.notFound: We couldn't find that video or track: it may not exist or be private.
add.duplicate: This song already has that link.

metronome.title: Metronome
metronome.compoundHint: In compound meters BPM counts the dotted quarter (each beat is 3 eighth notes).
metronome.oddHint: In odd meters BPM counts eighth notes; accents mark the groups (7/8 = 2+2+3).
metronome.silentHint: Sound off: follow the pulse on screen.

upload.title: Upload song
upload.intro: Paste chords the way other sites show them (chords over lyrics) or in ChordPro. Every chord is checked before publishing.
upload.keyHelp: The one it's written in. e.g. G, Am, Bb
upload.tempoHelp: 30 to 300. Don't know it? Press Tap along with the song.
upload.sourcePlaceholder:
G         D/F#
Walking down the road
Em7        C
under a silver sky
upload.previewEmpty: The preview shows up here as you type.
upload.chordErrors: Unrecognized chords: {chords}. Fix them to publish.

errors.invalid_key: Invalid key. Use, for example, G, Am or Bb.
errors.invalid_tempo: Tempo must be a number from 30 to 300.
errors.unexpected: We couldn't publish the song. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: Only the person who uploaded this version (or a moderator) can change it.
errors.original_has_versions: This is the original version and the song has other versions, so it cannot be deleted.
errors.recording_not_found: Could not find {detail}: the video does not exist or is private.
errors.invalid_directive: Check {detail}: the value is invalid or does not fit the meter.
errors.duplicate_recording: This song already has that link.

upload.subtitle: Paste chords the way you would copy them from another site. We check every chord and show how it looks before publishing.
upload.formatHint: Chords on their own line, above the syllable where they change, or in [brackets] (ChordPro).
upload.notationHint: We use letter notation (A, B, C…). If you paste Do, Re, Mi we offer to convert them.
upload.noSuggestion: We don't recognize it: check how it's written.
upload.versionSubtitle: Share another way to play {title}: easier, reharmonized, for piano…
upload.descriptionHelp: Optional. What changes compared to the original.
upload.tempoInheritHelp: Leave it empty to use the song's ({bpm} BPM).
upload.editSubtitle: {title} · changes show on the version page right away.

advanced.title: Advanced options: sections, bars and tempo changes
advanced.sections: Sections: write the name on its own line.
advanced.bars: Bars: mark them with |. Chords in a bar share it, and an empty bar holds the chord before it. Without bar lines, each chord lasts one bar.
advanced.barsExample:
| G     D   | Em      |  |
  Walking down the street
advanced.changes: Changes in a section: on their own lines, at the start of the section. Whatever you don't change carries on.

changesItems.text: where the accents of the bar fall
speed up or slow down: from 140 to 120 BPM over 4 bars

advanced.repeats: Repeats: |: to start and :| to end (:|x3 for three times). A whole section: “x2” in its name. Endings and jumps, on their own lines:

repeatItems.text: what follows is the 1st ending (up to :|)
jump to the Coda the second time
go back to the top and end at Fine

auth.title: Sign in to Acordia
auth.subtitle: You need an account to upload songs and versions. Viewing and transposing chords stays free, no account needed.
auth.privacy: We only use your Google name, photo and email. We never post anything on your behalf.

favorites.title: Your favorites
favorites.subtitle: Versions you saved to practice. Only you can see them.
favorites.empty: You have not saved any version yet. Press “Save” on a version page to keep it here.
